workflows.name: tfbs_motif_enrichment
workflows.intent: Identify enriched transcription factor binding motifs and predict candidate target genes from a gene list.
input: gene_list.txt (a list of gene symbols or genomic regions)
motif_rankings.db (genome-wide cross-species rankings database for motifs)
workflows.stages: 1. Identify DNA motifs over-represented near the transcription start site (TSS) using the ranking database ;; 2. Filter and retain motifs annotated to TFs with a high Normalized Enrichment Score (NES) ;; 3. Predict candidate target genes ranked above the leading edge for each enriched motif.
